description.value: Gandoum Bakery is a takeaway-only bakery on Marine Drive in North Vancouver, serving the West Vancouver waterfront corridor. Operating under the Gandoum Bakery Catering LTD brand, it is a neighbourhood stop for baked goods with no indoor or outdoor seating. For touring cyclists on the Marine Drive route, it offers a quick food pickup option near the shore.
